title: GPOM Chorus 2
heading: GitPush Origin Master ▲ chorus 2
moodboard_intro: Chorus 1's world, closer and harder, then it moves. Dashed cards are chorus 1 as it is now. Tap This, Maybe or No; leave a note per beat.
storyboard_intro: Frames in story order. Pick one still and one way to animate each.

beats.name: Among the ranks
beats.blurb: Down among the robes at robot height, rows of red eyes into the haze.

beats.name: The hooded robot, closer
beats.blurb: Closer than chorus 1: the eyes, the metal under the hood.

beats.name: The searchlights
beats.blurb: The ship's searchlights sweep the ranks; the ship overhead as a ceiling.

beats.name: The eye, nearer
beats.blurb: The ring, the red dots, the aperture, nearer than chorus 1.

beats.name: The ships come
beats.blurb: Second pass. Many hulls descending through cloud over the parade ground.

beats.name: The army moves
beats.blurb: Ambitious. Fallback: one block moving, or every head turning at once.

beats.name: The eye turns to us
beats.blurb: The eye on the mountain turns towards camera.

beats.name: The beam over the empty town
beats.blurb: The visible cost: the beam crosses an empty town at the mountain's foot.
